values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. note: DEC (Adirondack), New Russia, about 6 miles from Elizabethtown; loop sites 1-15 are on the pond. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $18 + $5 non-resident, 1-night reservation minimum and phone (DEC 2026 summary), 2027 opening May 14, ReserveAmerica booking, no electric, 35 sites to 30 ft (now manual). NEW: season close 09-05, 9-month window and 14-night max (were inherited), all drive-in sites back-in, showers/dump/water confirmed. Note: dropped site-count/length/facility/booking restatements and the '24 + 10 + 3' breakdown (RA: 24 loop + 10 remote, 3 of the remote boat-only).
flags: Season note (manual, 2026-10-20) says 'Reservable through Sep 5, 2027 (Labor Day weekend); DEC posts no later date.' DEC's 2026 summary does post a close: 'Lincoln Pond ... May 15 ... Sept 7' (Labor Day 2026). Suggest: 'Closes on Labor Day: Sep 7 in 2026 (DEC summary), Sep 5 in 2027 (ReserveAmerica).'
Minor: only 5 of the 24 drive-in sites are listed at 30 ft (sites 1, 2, 8, 9, 13); 13 are listed at 20 ft, so a 23-ft rig must pick its site.
